title: BuyMetal.com Closed: NOX METALS vs Hadco for Aluminum Plate
summary: BuyMetal.com's online store has closed. Hadco accepts quote requests for cut-to-size material; NOX METALS shows an instant delivered price and ship date for stocked plate.
body_markdown:
### Can I still buy from BuyMetal.com online?


No. Hadco says the BuyMetal.com online store has closed. Send Hadco a request for a quote instead.


### Does Hadco still offer cut-to-size aluminum?


Hadco says it continues to offer the same materials and cut-to-size services, including plate and bar sawing. Confirm the exact alloy, dimensions, documentation, and timing in its quote.


### Does Hadco have a minimum order?


The closure notice does not state a minimum. Ask Hadco about the minimum charge and delivered total for your job.


### Can NOX show a ship date before I order?


Yes. NOX shows the price and ship date in the instant quote for material available in its online catalog.
